summary: Build practical HR GDPR compliance skills through ROPA, DPIA, rights requests, and breach exercises. Enrol in the five-day course.
lede: GDPR HR training covers how organizations document and manage employee-data processing across HR activities. It is for HR managers, operations professionals, privacy officers, DPOs, and people analytics specialists who need to apply data protection requirements in operational workflows. Learners assess lawful bases and maintain processing records, screen data protection impact assessment risks, and build workflows for data subject requests, retention, access, breaches, and processor oversight.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage employee information, HR technology, privacy controls, and workforce reporting. It suits intermediate practitioners who already work with HR processes or compliance responsibilities and need a structured way to apply GDPR requirements in operational settings.
prerequisites: You should have working experience in HR operations, HR technology, privacy, information security, audit, or employee-data governance. Familiarity with organizational policies and common HR records is useful. No programming is required. You will apply templates and structured digital workflows rather than configure production systems.
